doc.title: Epic 6 Technical Specification: PWA Reliability & Accessibility
doc.snippet: Defines Workbox-powered service worker with precaching strategy for shell assets, optional audio caching with consent, offline fallback UI, and SW update flow. Contains authoritative AC6.1.1-AC6.1.9 acceptance criteria.

doc.title: Epic 6 Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Defines useServiceWorker hook API: swStatus, updateAvailable, isOffline, cacheStatus states; registerServiceWorker, checkForUpdates, applyUpdate, clearAudioCache actions; audioCacheConsent toggle.

doc.title: Epic 6 Technical Specification
doc.section: Data Models: Service Worker Cache Strategy
doc.snippet: Workbox config structure with precacheManifest for shell assets and runtimeCaching rules for Google Fonts (StaleWhileRevalidate) and audio (CacheFirst with consent plugin).

doc.title: Epic 6 Technical Specification
doc.snippet: App loads → SW registers → precaches shell → activates runtime caching. Offline detected: show banner, disable streaming, enable cached playback. Update cycle: detect new version → show toast → skipWaiting → reload.

doc.title: Architecture – mp3_to_8D
doc.snippet: Workbox CLI generates SW with precacheManifest for shell assets (HTML, CSS, JS, icons) and runtime caching for fonts/images. Audio files only cached when user opts in. Offline fallback page surfaces when user navigates without cached assets.

doc.title: Architecture – mp3_to_8D
doc.snippet: Offline reliability: Service worker precache + IndexedDB persistence; offline banner informs users when streaming disabled. Automated Playwright test simulates offline drag/drop playback.

doc.title: Architecture – mp3_to_8D
doc.snippet: Global providers wrap the tree: AudioGraphProvider, PresetProvider, SessionProvider, SensorProvider, ThemeProvider. Event bus coordinates cross-cutting events enabling telemetry and UI toast sync.

constraints.constraint: Single-file architecture - all React implementation in index.html
Workbox config and generated SW at project root level
Use existing toast notification patterns from E2/E5 for offline and update notifications
Use existing Settings panel structure for audio cache consent toggle
localStorage keys must follow existing convention: mp3_8d_* or mpe_8d_*
IndexedDB stores (presets, sessions, sensor_consent) must remain accessible offline
All UI elements must include ARIA attributes (role, aria-label, aria-live)
Toast notifications must support reduced-motion preference
SW install time <3s, offline page load <1s, cache-first audio playback <500ms
Unit tests for registration lifecycle, update detection, offline state
No credential storage in SW cache; HTTPS required for SW registration

interface.name: useServiceWorker hook
interface.signature: const { swStatus, updateAvailable, isOffline, audioCacheConsent, registerServiceWorker, applyUpdate, setAudioCacheConsent } = useServiceWorker()

tests.standards: Project uses Node.js test runner (built-in) with fake-indexeddb for storage mocking. Tests are standalone .test.js files with describe/test blocks. Each test file imports functionality and validates expected behavior. Tests run via npm test command which chains all test files. Follow existing patterns in heart-rate-engine.test.js which has 36 tests covering registration, state changes, and event handling.
